It must at least equal the weight of fifty atmospheres. One whaleman has estimated it at the weight of twenty line-of-battle ships" — this entire digression is ABSENT/compressed to one clause

- The atmospheric pressure digression (fifty atmospheres, twenty line-of-battle ships) is distinctive expository voice and interpretive — medium to high

- "young whales, in the highest health, and swelling with noble aspirations, prematurely cut off in the warm flush and May of life, with all their panting lard about them" — voice-establishing ironic pathos — absent — medium
- "enchanted in him" (vs "chained in him") — minor — low
